'''Lu Wei-chih''' ({{zh|t=呂偉智}}, born 19 March 1979) is a Taiwanese [[professional golfer]].

== Career ==
Lu plays on the [[Asian Tour]], where he has won three times and on the [[Japan Golf Tour]]. He has represented Taiwan twice in the [[World Cup (men's golf)|World Cup]].
